saints.name: St. Mechtilde of Hackeborn
saints.title: Virgin
saints.shortBlurb: The Benedictine nun of Helfta whose visions of the Heart of Christ were treasured by St. Gertrude the Great…
biography: Born about 1241 of a noble Saxon family, Mechtilde entered the monastery of Helfta, where her elder sister Gertrude of Hackeborn was abbess. Gifted with a beautiful voice, she led the choir and was called by her sisters the nightingale of Christ, and she became a wise and beloved mistress and guide of souls.

She was the spiritual teacher of the younger St. Gertrude the Great, and it was Gertrude and another sister who set down Mechtilde's mystical graces in the Book of Special Grace, a work rich in devotion to the Sacred Heart. She died at Helfta in 1298.
saints.knownFor: The mystical revelations recorded in the Book of Special Grace.

sources.text: The Roman Martyrology (1914 English ed.; public domain)
